boundaries: No numerical source, dependency lock, frozen gate, docs, or TASKS file was changed.
No workflow was dispatched and nothing was pushed.

findings.evidence: Every pytest command now loads tests.helpers.installed_wheel_guard; the guard rejects checkout src and any package path outside site-packages. The forcing job now also performs a preflight origin assertion.

test_persistent_jit_cache previously read ROOT/src and set PYTHONPATH=ROOT/src. It now derives both source and subprocess import root from the distribution imported by pytest and is included in own-met wheel CI.

The workflow fetches Homebrew gdal.rb at commit 3c01d2c89227ced6d17c28d6a784b675c991b33e, verifies formula SHA-256 71ecda409f008f599b15b10f0fe6f51f8f7d052ee91f1082a801ce2ca9d3c05f, installs through an ephemeral trusted tap with auto-update disabled, and retains the GDAL 3.13.3 runtime assertion. The pinned formula embeds arm64 Sequoia bottle digest b5bd7be5f0fc49779221aa059e0d3d9ed94c8fd5c950a5526061e058c79b7a65. Transitive Homebrew formula dependencies remain resolved by Homebrew.

macos-14 is in deprecation and macos-14 denotes arm64. Jobs now use macos-15, which GitHub documents as arm64, and fail immediately unless uname -m is arm64, matching the frozen macos-arm64 requirement locks.

not_run: GitHub-hosted macos-15 jobs were not dispatched.
Pinned GDAL was not installed; the formula download, checksum, trusted tap parsing, and cleanup were validated locally.
The full CPU-reference matrix was not rerun.

validation.detail: pytest_configure rejected checkout source before collection; consequently pytest emitted no JUnit file.
Formula SHA verified, parsed after trust, and task-created tap removed by checked EXIT trap; no local GDAL install performed.
